final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM "order" WHERE amount > 2802.0 GROUP BY k_symbol), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.k_symbol, step1.avg_amount, step1.avg_amount - step2.overall_avg FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE step1.avg_amount > step2.overall_avg
